annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于推行常住地提供基本公共服务的实施意见
annotation.title_en: State Council Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Provision of Basic Public Services at Place of Habitual Residence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council implementation opinions (Guofa [2026] No. 11) on providing basic public services based on place of habitual residence rather than household registration, covering migrant children's education, public rental housing, social insurance, healthcare, employment and social assistance. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Decouple basic public services from hukou so non-registered residents get equal access
Expand public rental housing and migrant children's schooling guarantees
Remove household registration limits on employee social insurance in place of employment
Allocate fiscal transfers and construction land according to resident population
NDRC to monitor and evaluate implementation; pilots in regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and Yangtze River Delta
